block.vastenchanting.arcane_archive.desc: Put enchanted books in: they're kept as points. Take enchantments back out onto books, up to level 16. Keeps them when broken.
block.vastenchanting.relic_shelf.desc: A table that reads it also offers treasure enchantments.
block.vastenchanting.veto_bookcase.desc: Holds up to five enchanted books: a table that reads it won't offer their enchantments.
block.vastenchanting.void_archive.desc: Put enchanted books in: they're kept as points. Take enchantments back out onto books, up to level 31. Keeps them when broken.
item.vastenchanting.bound_tome.desc: At an anvil, with an enchanted item: all its enchantments go into a book. The item is lost.
item.vastenchanting.siphon_tome.desc: At an anvil, with an enchanted item: all its enchantments go into a book, and the item comes back plain and worn.
item.vastenchanting.tattered_tome.desc: At an anvil, with an enchanted item: about half its enchantments go into a book. The item is lost.
vastenchanting.archive.click: Left click: one level more on the bottom book
vastenchanting.archive.click_max: Right click: as high as the points allow
vastenchanting.archive.cost: Level %s costs %s points from a plain book
vastenchanting.archive.empty: Nothing stored yet: put an enchanted book in the top slot.
vastenchanting.archive.max: Up to level %s (this archive keeps up to %s)
vastenchanting.chaos.desc: How much each offer's strength varies, up or down.
vastenchanting.clues.desc: How many of each offer's enchantments are shown before you choose.
vastenchanting.power.desc: How strong the offers get: the top offer costs this many levels.
vastenchanting.rarity.desc: Favours rare enchantments; at 25 and 75 an offer gains another.
